content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher with 9 years of experience in meat counter service and butchery, including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and fresh sausage production. Experienced in advising customers on cuts and cooking, maintaining cold-chain temperature records, and following hygiene and cleaning routines. HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate, renewed in 2024.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Prepare approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per week in the busy season, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily; rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, with older stock at the front.
- Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday and advise on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery for weddings and family events. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial for beef ribs, keeping weight-loss and temperature records. Dry-aged ribs are now sold on pre-order, at approximately 15 kg per month.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
- Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist covering the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate in Butchery (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher examination (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning and trimming · Portioning fresh meat · Fresh sausage making · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · FIFO stock rotation · Cold-chain temperature checks · HACCP hygiene routines · Customer service and product advice · Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good; customer communication) · German (basic)


COVER LETTER

Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I have nine years of experience in butchery and meat counter service, completed vocational butcher training, and hold a HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate renewed in 2024.

In my current role, I break down beef and pork, bone and portion meat for the counter, and prepare fresh sausages. I also advise customers on cuts and cooking times, serve around 120 customers on a Saturday, and rotate stock using FIFO. I record cold-room and display-counter temperatures twice daily and follow established hygiene and cleaning routines.

I would bring hands-on butchery experience as well as a strong focus on approachable customer service and careful food handling. I developed our lamb merguez recipe and adapted our ćevapi mix in response to customer feedback; the ćevapi later won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair. FreshCart’s emphasis on knowledgeable, honest advice and fresh food aligns well with the work I do at the counter.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the FreshCart meat counter team.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

Delete every part of the CV from it: its sections, headings, bullet lists, dates and skill lists. Keep only the cover letter itself (with its own header, if it has one), unchanged. The CV is sent as a separate document.

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well tailored to FreshCart and the Zagreb-Jarun Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It clearly presents the candidate’s nine years of relevant experience, completed butcher training, HACCP certification, customer-service experience, FIFO stock rotation, temperature checks, and sausage-production achievement. The quantified examples—approximately 120 Saturday customers and the award-winning ćevapi—add credibility and impact. The tone is appropriate and the letter avoids unsupported claims. It could be marginally stronger by using the exact job title and the phrase “HACCP knowledge” in the opening, but these are minor refinements.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter uses ATS-relevant terms supported by the candidate’s information, including “butchery,” “meat counter service,” “butcher training,” “HACCP,” “bone,” “portion,” “fresh sausages,” “customers,” “FIFO,” “temperature,” “hygiene,” and “cleaning routines.” Its plain text structure, standard headings, and conventional paragraph format should parse well. The letter does not claim unsupported supermarket, self-service packaging, tray-sealer, labelling-scale, or forklift experience, which is appropriate. AI screening probability is high because the document directly connects the candidate’s experience to the core requirements and duties.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document strongly matches both must-have requirements: completed butcher training and HACCP knowledge. It also aligns well with the role’s duties by demonstrating cutting, boning, portioning, fresh sausage preparation, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, temperature recording, and hygiene routines. The customer-service paragraph reflects FreshCart’s culture of knowledgeable, approachable, honest advice, while the product-development example demonstrates pride in good work. The candidate’s material shows a gap for the nice-to-have forklift licence, and the candidate has not worked with supermarket self-service packaging or the listed labelling equipment; these are not defects in the letter and should not be implied. The letter appropriately omits unsupported claims about those areas.
critique.improvement_instructions: Minor enhancement only: In the opening paragraph, change “I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store” to “I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant (m/f/d) position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store.” In the same paragraph, change “hold a HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate renewed in 2024” to “have HACCP knowledge supported by a HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate renewed in 2024.” This uses the job ad’s exact title and requirement wording without adding unsupported qualifications.
